# Clean the wash dock

[All care guides](README.md)

![Clean the wash dock](../img/wash_dock--water_tanks.svg)

**What it does**

The wash dock rinses the mop. Dirt in its tray or a full dirty-water tank stops the washing.

**How to**

1. Take out the dirty-water tank, empty it and rinse it.
2. Lift out the wash tray and rinse it under running water.
3. Wipe the base of the dock dry and put the tray and the tank back.
4. Fill the clean-water tank if it is low.

> **Note** Let the tray dry before the robot goes back onto it.
